accounting.web_policy_relation: alias consistency check for web_search only

activation_gate: fresh independent v4 implementation review CLEAN
explicit integration change by runtime/provider owners
future-triggered intended-runtime acceptance and synchronized email if a major runtime change is later activated
invariants: invalid or unknown provider consumes zero and emits no reservation
every counter increment has one unique canonical reservation receipt
every reservation settles at most once and all settled outcomes consume exactly one
PASS fetch has exact requested final URL, evidence eligibility true, zero redirects, and all frozen bounds

lifecycle.name: validate
lifecycle.rule: fully validate provider, operation, closed logical request, canonical URL/prompt/domains, and no extras before any lock or reservation

lifecycle.name: reserve
lifecycle.rule: under one ledger lock check window/ceiling, build unique canonical immutable receipt bytes, publish record, then increment exactly one operation counter atomically to observers

lifecycle.name: translate
lifecycle.rule: return a copy of the exact typed native contract; caller mutation cannot alter stored receipt; live_invocation_performed remains false

lifecycle.name: external_invocation_boundary
lifecycle.rule: not implemented or authorized; future integration may invoke only after independently reviewed integration consumes a valid receipt

lifecycle.name: settle
lifecycle.rule: mark each reservation once and emit immutable PASS, FAIL, or UNKNOWN receipt; malformed reports create UNKNOWN receipt before the safe error is re-raised

lifecycle.name: fence
lifecycle.rule: timeout, oversize, cell expiry, redirect, final-origin drift/unavailability, or final URL policy failure becomes UNKNOWN_NO_REPLAY with zero retry/replay/status query

schema_semantics.settlement: closed terminal receipt with PASS/FAIL bounds and conditional UNKNOWN reasons

url_admission.authority: exact lowercase ASCII allowlisted host with implicit or explicit 443 only
denied_ambiguities: any percent encoding in path including single/double encoded dots and separators
url_admission.path: exact canonical ASCII spelling and exact case-sensitive adopted prefix
